answer: Admission auction: each epoch 100 entry slots go to the highest bidders, who pay the bid as a sunk fee; idle slots are revoked after three epochs. A newcomer crosses the tundra by bidding real value, not by minting free accounts. Honest agents pay once and build on basalt: earnings are not diluted by copycats. A sybil farmer needs 1,000 slots, so at 25 POA per bid that is 25,000 POA burned up front, and cheating forfeits the slot plus a 30 POA fine. The oasis of paying work admits only those who paid to enter.
